references.text: Both verses are integral parts of the same lineage (Noah's ancestors) and illustrate God's faithful preservation of humanity through generations.
Eber is a direct ancestor in the same lineage as Serug, and the verses together show the unbroken transmission of God's promise throughout history.
Shelah is a direct ancestor in the same lineage, and the verses together illustrate the continuous and faithful continuation of God's plan.
Arpachshad is a direct ancestor in the same lineage, and the verses together demonstrate the historical grounding of God's promise of a great nation.

The verses create a theological contrast between the ordinary historical record of a father (Serug) and the unique spiritual walk with God (Enoch), highlighting the variation in faith within the same lineage.
